closure_rationale: All named D14 gaps have exact static ownership and relevant live confirmation. The bee has a species strike path and causal health-loss replay; dragonfly has a wander-only species program and sound-only callback; both families have positive targetability states and the bee has a negative eligibility switch. Remaining generic enemy collision behavior is shared-system work, not a D14-specific unknown.
